summary: You give /api/chat two promises: a schema-valid ChatAnswer (or a 502) and a live stream that ends with done or error. Tests with a scripted fake model hold three paths (good, invalid after the retry, broken halfway), and a terminal client reads the stream.
goal: Give /api/chat a schema-valid answer and a live stream, with tests for the good path and both failure paths.

items.text: Part A: write down the ChatAnswer fields and what the client sees on each of the three paths
Part B: make /api/chat return a validated ChatAnswer and match the curl output
Part C: check /api/chat/stream sends done or error and match the curl -N output
Part D: write tests for the good path, the 502 path and both stream paths, and see them pass with no key
Parts E and F: run the terminal client and stop the server in the middle of a stream
Parts G and H: try one real answer, add the README and note, then commit and push
Play the Chat Contract game to the end and see your score
